'''Kel Dandu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] director who planned to make a documentary on [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] girls. As a child, Dandu was a slave himself.<ref name="GatORW" />
